# Generated folder - do not edit directly

The `.ps1` files in this folder are a **copy** of `scripts/windows/*.ps1`,
regenerated by `tools/Build-Module.ps1`.

If you need to fix or change diagnostic script behavior:

1. Edit the file in `scripts/windows/`, not here.
2. Run `./tools/Build-Module.ps1` from the repo root.
3. Commit both the source change and the regenerated file(s) here together.

CI will fail the build (job `verify-module-sync`) if this folder ever gets
out of sync with `scripts/windows/`, so a mismatch won't merge silently -
but it's still faster to just run the build script than to wait for CI to
catch it.
